name: Active and malformed stop suppress every watcher entrypoint and report once at turn end
Invalid resumption, wrong-home receipts, impossible timestamps and symlinks fail closed
Absent or explicitly resumed stop preserves the guard and a real registered-check wake
Parked Mini does not count as work; ordinary work still requires supervision unless stopped
Stop during a Codex checkpoint exit or timeout returns deliberate-stop status
Stopping a running watcher retires both owning and attached arms without a repair prompt
